about_the_game:
Return to the enchanted forest in the DLC of "Enchanted Stories: Mystic Woods" and discover four brand-new locations brimming with untold secrets, more hidden objects to find, and even more puzzles to solve! The Mystic Woods beckon you once again, offering fresh adventures, fabled creatures in need of rescue, and the chance to restore balance to this magical realm. 

Dive into all-new quests, from brewing the elusive Potion of Divination on a table laden with enchanted ingredients, to purifying the waters of the Waterfall Valley with the help of a friendly turtle. Heal a wounded living tree on Whispering Hill, rescue defenseless owl chicks from cruel lumberjacks, and test your puzzle-solving prowess at every turn!

✨ BREW THE POTION OF DIVINATION!

On a table full of magical items, you discover a recipe you need to prepare! Gather rare ingredients, measure carefully, and complete challenging mini-games to craft the perfect potion! But beware — one wrong move could ruin everything!

✨ HEAL THE TREE!

On Whispering Hill, you come across a living tree whose eyes are closed and branches have been cut off. Once mighty, ancient tree has been wounded by the cruel lumberjacks. Solve intricate puzzles to restore its strength and awaken its wisdom!

✨ HELP THE OWL CHICKS!

The adorable owl chicks have been displaced and harmed by the cruel lumberjacks. They’re counting on you to save them! Search their massive nest for vital items, carve a sacred idol, and retrieve a lost healing scroll to save them.

✨ PURIFY THE WATERS IN THE WATERFALL VALLEY!

Tainted by dark magic, the once-lush Waterfall Valley is in desperate need of cleansing. Navigate twisting cave passages, searching for clues and mystical artifacts to break the foul enchantment!

Experience the next chapter of "Enchanted Stories: Mystic Woods" as you safeguard the forest’s magic and prove once more that you are its true guardian!
